description: Candlestick price chart with indicators for a public ticker. Use it when someone wants to see a chart, such as a daily chart of AAPL with SMA and RSI; for values alone, use get_indicators. Pass symbol as a Yahoo-style ticker: AAPL, BRK-B, EUR/USD, BTC-USD, or GOLD (drawn as GC=F). Turn a company name into its ticker first, for example Apple is AAPL. Optional: timeframe (5m, 15m, 1h, 1d, 1w; 1d by default), indicators (up to 4 of 12, such as sma, rsi, macd, bollinger or adx; volume is always drawn) and theme (dark or light). Returns an inline card, the full interactive chart page as html, an openUrl for the same chart, and a short plain-language read of the last price and the indicator values, with the source and as-of time. Do not use it for news, fundamentals, earnings, a portfolio, orders, or buy or sell opinions; those need a different source. Public prices only. Informational only, not financial advice.

indicators.description: Up to 4. Volume is always drawn. Defaults to sma and rsi when omitted.

periods.description: Lookback per indicator, in bars, such as {"sma": 50}. A period applies only when its indicator is in indicators. MACD stays 12, 26, 9, and VWAP and OBV have no length, so none has an entry.

adx.description: 14 bars by default. Used only when adx is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

atr.description: 14 bars by default. Used only when atr is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

bollinger.description: 20 bars by default. Used only when bollinger is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

cci.description: 20 bars by default. Used only when cci is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

ema.description: 20 bars by default. Used only when ema is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

rsi.description: 14 bars by default. Used only when rsi is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

sma.description: 20 bars by default. Used only when sma is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

stochastic.description: 14 bars by default. Used only when stochastic is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

williams_r.description: 14 bars by default. Used only when williams_r is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

symbol.description: Yahoo-style ticker, such as "AAPL". Also accepted: BRK-B, EUR/USD or EURUSD, BTC-USD or BTCUSD, GOLD (GC=F), SPX. Turn a company name into its ticker first: Apple is AAPL.

name: chart

asOf.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last bar, or of the call when status is not ok

bars.description: Bars on the chart. 0 when status is not ok.

changePercent.description: Percent change from the previous close to the last close. null when status is not ok.

currency.description: Price currency code from the source, such as USD. Empty when the source gives none.

error.description: Present when status is not ok

hint.description: The next step: what to change or tell the user

html.description: Large: the full chart page, a self-contained interactive HTML document, only when status is ok. Pass it on unchanged, or give the user openUrl instead; never rewrite, shorten or summarize it. Vela attribution stays on.

latest.description: Latest values of the study, in the price currency except RSI, stochastic and ADX (0 to 100), Williams %R (0 to -100), CCI (no fixed range) and OBV (volume)

value.description: sma, ema, rsi, atr, vwap, cci, williams_r and obv value

params.description: Settings used for the study. Empty for vwap and obv.

deviations.description: Bollinger Band width in standard deviations

lastClose.description: Last close in the price currency. null when status is not ok.

notice.description: Not-financial-advice notice. Show it with the read.

openUrl.description: Same chart on chart.openkrill.app, redrawn from public prices

read.description: Plain-language description of the chart. Not financial advice. Empty when status is not ok.

skipped.description: Requested indicators that could not be calculated

reason.description: Why, such as too few bars or no volume

source.description: Price source: Yahoo Finance, Coinbase, or ECB reference rates through Frankfurter. Empty, or the failing source, when status is not ok.

status.description: ok, or why there is no chart; error.hint then says what to do next

symbol.description: Symbol as drawn, such as AAPL, EUR/USD, BTC-USD or GC=F

title: Price chart
